sounds.name: Card Play
sounds.description: Played when any card is placed from hand

sounds.name: Unit Death
sounds.description: Short descending cry when a mobile unit is destroyed

sounds.name: Building Destroyed
sounds.description: Deep crumbling crash when a structure is destroyed

sounds.name: Unit Attack
sounds.description: Quick strike sound when a player unit attacks (throttled)

sounds.name: Base Hit
sounds.description: Heavy impact when a unit damages a base

sounds.name: Battle Start
sounds.description: Rising 3-note war-horn fanfare at the start of a battle

sounds.name: Upgrade
sounds.description: Ascending sparkle when a player structure is upgraded

sounds.name: Victory
sounds.description: Short ascending melody on winning a battle

sounds.name: Defeat
sounds.description: Descending lament on losing a battle

sounds.name: Battle Event
sounds.description: Dramatic sting when a mid-battle event fires

sounds.name: Button Click
sounds.description: Subtle tick on UI button presses

sounds.name: Card Flip
sounds.description: Soft swish when cards are revealed or flipped

sounds.name: Rest Heal
sounds.description: Gentle ascending chord at rest-node healing

sounds.name: Mana Gain
sounds.description: Rising double-tone when mana increases

sounds.name: Minigame Correct
sounds.description: Bright ping for a correct guess or successful catch

sounds.name: Minigame Wrong
sounds.description: Low buzz for a wrong guess, mismatch, or bomb

sounds.name: Shop Purchase
sounds.description: Ka-ching ascending coin tink when buying from a shop or merchant

sounds.name: Fruit Machine Spin
sounds.description: Short mechanical click-whirr each time the reels begin spinning

sounds.name: Fruit Machine Win
sounds.description: Punchy ascending fanfare when the fruit machine pays out

sounds.name: Fruit Machine Lose
sounds.description: Descending sawtooth lament when the fruit machine resets to zero

sounds.name: Map Footstep
sounds.description: Soft thud when the player avatar begins walking to a new node
